name: Hindustan Ambassador Mark IV
description: The Hindustan Ambassador Mark IV — India's most beloved automobile and a true national icon. This beautifully restored example in Ivory White features the Isuzu engine upgrade, original chrome trim, and a lovingly refurbished beige interior. A rolling piece of Indian history.
heritage: The Ambassador served as India's official state car for over four decades. Every bureaucrat and dignitary rode in one.

name: Premier Padmini (Fiat 1100)
description: The Premier Padmini — the Italian Fiat 1100 that became Mumbai's most famous taxi and a darling of Indian roads for over 40 years. This canary yellow example has been fully restored with period-correct parts and features an original chrome grille in exceptional condition.
heritage: Immortalised as the yellow taxi of Mumbai, the Padmini became the heartbeat of a city. This example ran as a private car its entire life.

name: Mahindra CJ-3B Short Jeep
description: The Mahindra CJ-3B — the original Indian Jeep that built a nation. Known as the 'Short Jeep', this iconic 4x4 was used by the Indian Army, farmers, and adventurers alike. Restored to military-spec in authentic Olive Drab with the legendary Hurricane F-head engine running perfectly.
heritage: Based on the legendary Willys CJ-3B, this jeep is the grandfather of every modern Mahindra. An unbreakable icon of the Indian countryside.

name: Willys MB American Jeep
description: The Willys MB — the original American Jeep that helped win World War II and became the most influential vehicle in automotive history. This 1943 example has been subjected to a frame-off concours restoration using genuine Willys parts. Verified by documentation as a South Asian Theatre vehicle.
heritage: Officially documented as a WWII South Asian Theatre vehicle. One of the most historically significant automobiles in our collection.

name: Jeep Wrangler YJ
description: The Jeep Wrangler YJ — the square-headlight classic that defined a generation of off-roaders. This Hunter Green example features the bulletproof 4.0L AMC inline-six, a Bestop soft top, and upgraded suspension. It runs and drives flawlessly and is ready for any adventure.
heritage: Imported directly from the United States in 1994. Maintained exclusively by a Jeep enthusiast club member for 20 years.
